about: The web push payload each subscribed device is sent, before encryption (refactor plan step S10). The override run sets OPENV_PUSH_NOTIFICATION_TYPES to exactly the types the default allow-list leaves out.

deliveries.scenario: artifact.status_changed to in_review by its owner, titled with quotes

sends.payload: {"title":"Artifact ready for review","body":"\"Brake \\\"pedal\\\" force ≤ 50 N\" is waiting in the review queue.","url":"/projects/proj-apollo/requirements","tag":"review_requested:proj-apollo"}

deliveries.scenario: artifact.status_changed to in_review with no title, by the system

sends.payload: {"title":"Artifact ready for review","body":"An artifact is waiting in the review queue.","url":"/projects/proj-apollo/requirements","tag":"review_requested:proj-apollo"}
